title: Amplification languages are logarithmic-space decidable
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet and every index $j\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, the $j$th language in the four-language family associated with $N$ belongs to logarithmic space.
